alignment_reasoning: The image fails the majority of diagnostic checkpoints (7 out of 9). Crucially, it fails the primary functional requirement of a street sign: legible, standardized text for navigation. The text is AI-generated gibberish ('HAICIA'). Furthermore, it fails the geometric constraint of being mounted on a 'vertical post', appearing instead as wall-mounted signage. The classifier's failure to identify it as a street sign (predicting 'tobacco shop') confirms the lack of defining class features.
artifact_reasoning: Severe text generation artifacts dominate the evaluation. The upper sign is completely illegible (Severity 5), and the lower sign contains nonsensical text (Severity 4). Secondary artifacts include unnatural neon glow bleeding into the brickwork and slight perspective wavering in the building facade. The image exhibits characteristic AI 'painterly' texture rather than realistic material properties.
